start: Member: Settings, Your gym, the 'Messages from my gym' switch

steps.action: Read the switch and switch it off
user_sees: 'Get a pop-up when Iron Den sends news, like a holiday, new timings or an offer. It can take a few minutes to reach you.'

must_not: The phone asking for notifications before the member switches it on
